title: Roasted Edamame with Sea Salt
description: Crispy roasted soybeans seasoned with sea salt and a hint of sesame for a plant-based protein snack.
steps: Toss the thawed edamame with sesame oil, salt and garlic powder.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast at 200C for 20-25 minutes until golden.
notes: Roasting removes moisture so these keep well for days — good as a shelf-stable, portable protein snack.
